subject: Paid Parking Program and Peace Garden Funding
overview: The Council approved a $1.3 million memorial garden for Boston Marathon victims and a drive-through permit for Panera Bread while addressing significant public opposition to the city's new paid parking program.

items.title: Special Permit for Drive-Through at Fellsway Plaza
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a drive-through for a Panera Bread at the Fellsway property with amendments requiring charcoal filtration systems and a six-month traffic review.

items.title: Petition on Citywide Parking Enforcement Program
items.summary: Business owners and residents protested the impending rollout of a citywide paid parking program and its 10-year contract with Republic Parking, citing high permit fees and a lack of public input. The Council passed motions to review the program 60 days after its launch and requested that the Traffic Commission study seasonal or part-time business permits.

items.title: Common Victualler License for The Lighthouse
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Leonard Tekja to operate The Lighthouse at 20 High Street.

items.title: Crystal Campbell Memorial Peace Garden Appropriation
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of state and federal grants along with private donations for the $1.3 million Crystal Campbell Memorial Peace Garden at the Medford Senior Center. The Council rejected an amendment to scale back the project by removing a planned fountain despite concerns regarding long-term maintenance costs.
